Author: The Enceladeum
Name: HOutfits
Punchline: Apply full sets to your character in Glamourer with a single click.
Description: Lists the game's complete named sets and applies a whole set or any single piece to your character through Glamourer, instead of picking each item from a dropdown.
Changelog: 0.2.1: fixes the NPC "appearance" apply. Eye shape, small iris, the seven facial features, legacy tattoo, highlights, lipstick and face paint now transfer correctly; several were previously dropped or sent out of range and silently kept your own values. Gear and name transfer are unchanged.
